comment.body:
Thanks for the clear Left Alt-to-`5` test in Notepad. The report lists PowerToys 0.92.1, and current Keyboard Manager has a specific modifier-to-character remap path. Could you please:
1. Retest on the latest stable v0.102.3001 with only that mapping enabled, pressing and releasing Left Alt in Notepad.
2. If it still produces no `5`, add a comment containing `/bugreport` immediately after reproducing.
This will distinguish an older regression from a current modifier-state or input-injection failure.
